items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Digger Wells went in my place.

ctx.x: Well, now, this is when -- let's see, Dickie Rouse says that you and Basie got together on a whole lot of things now, though, for the band, because the band was the band's personnel was changing a bit, wasn't it?
Yeah, well, I gave it a story -- we didn't get on anything -- well, Digger Wells went in my place.
